# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

Welcome to Medicines UK

# Better access, better health

We are the trade body representing the manufacturers and suppliers of nine out of 10 of the
prescription medicines used by the NHS. Via competition, these essential generic, biosimilar and
value-added medicines deliver more than £20 billion in annual savings to healthcare budgets. This
allows more patients to access the treatments they need.

[About us][55][Join us][56]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][57]

## Our approach

Medicines UK is the leading voice in the off-patent industry, dedicated to ensuring a sustainable
and cost-effective supply of essential generic, biosimilar and value-added medicines for UK
patients. By promoting collaboration between government, healthcare professionals and industry, we
drive growth and strengthen relationships, improving patient access and supply chains. We are
committed to building a healthier future by advocating for policies that support both the NHS and
medicine manufacturers, ensuring reliable access to life-saving treatments.

[Key issues][58]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][59]

## Our core values

**Advocacy:** We engage stakeholders to drive meaningful healthcare progress.

 

**Value:** We ensure better use of healthcare resources by delivering cost-effective medicines.

 

**Accessibility:** Our members' medicines allow more patients access to the treatment they need.

 

**Resilience:** We adapt and support our members to improve healthcare outcomes.

 

**Impact:** We deliver measurable change through expertise and passion.

 

 

[About us][60]

## Our new name

We recently launched our new name and brand: Medicines UK.

 

Our members supply the vast majority of prescription packs that the NHS relies on. Via off-patent
competition, we create billions of pounds of savings, allowing healthcare resources to go further
and do more. We also increase access, which allows more patients to receive the treatments they
need.

 

Please watch this short message from Mark Samuels, our chief executive, on why we have adopted a new
name.

Welcome to Medicines UK

# Better access, better health

We are the trade body representing the manufacturers and suppliers of nine out of 10 of the
prescription medicines used by the NHS. Via competition, these essential generic, biosimilar and
value-added medicines deliver more than £20 billion in annual savings to healthcare budgets. This
allows more patients to access the treatments they need.

[About us][55][Join us][56]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][57]

## Our approach

Medicines UK is the leading voice in the off-patent industry, dedicated to ensuring a sustainable
and cost-effective supply of essential generic, biosimilar and value-added medicines for UK
patients. By promoting collaboration between government, healthcare professionals and industry, we
drive growth and strengthen relationships, improving patient access and supply chains. We are
committed to building a healthier future by advocating for policies that support both the NHS and
medicine manufacturers, ensuring reliable access to life-saving treatments.

[Key issues][58]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][59]

## Our core values

**Advocacy:** We engage stakeholders to drive meaningful healthcare progress.

 

**Value:** We ensure better use of healthcare resources by delivering cost-effective medicines.

 

**Accessibility:** Our members' medicines allow more patients access to the treatment they need.

 

**Resilience:** We adapt and support our members to improve healthcare outcomes.

 

**Impact:** We deliver measurable change through expertise and passion.

 

 

[About us][60]
[
[Play button]
][61]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][62]

## Our new name

We recently launched our new name and brand: Medicines UK.

 

Our members supply the vast majority of prescription packs that the NHS relies on. Via off-patent
competition, we create billions of pounds of savings, allowing healthcare resources to go further
and do more. We also increase access, which allows more patients to receive the treatments they
need.

 

Please watch this short message from Mark Samuels, our chief executive, on why we have adopted a new
name.

## Join today

[Join us][63]

## Discover more

[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][64]

### [About us][65]

[Medicines UK is the leading voice of the off-patent sector, representing the interests of
manufacturers and suppliers of generic and biosimilar medicines and promoting the development of the
industry in the United Kingdom. Generics, biosimilars and value-added medicines fulfil nine out of
10 NHS patient prescriptions.][66]
[Read more][67]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][68]

### [Key issues][69]

[The core role of a successful off-patent sector is to get the right medicines at the right time to
the right patients to improve quality of life. This work also stimulates the originator sector to
continue research-based activity, which results in new and improved medicines for patients. There
are a number of issues important to our members, on which we engage with a range of stakeholders
from parliamentary representatives and government departments through to NHS England, the MHRA and
the EU.][70]
[Read more][71]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][72]

### [Our association][73]

[Medicines UK is the representative trade body of the off-patent sector. Generic and biosimilar
medicines fulfil nine out of 10 NHS patient prescriptions. We have 45 members that make up our
association and contribute to industry discussions, helping shape policy, raise awareness and
educate partners on the critical importance of the off-patent sector in running a safe and
sustainable NHS.][74]
[Read more][75]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][76]

### [Our structure][77]

[Led by Chief Executive Mark Samuels, Medicines UK is a dedicated team with specialist experience in
medicines manufacturing and regulation; supply chain and marketing; NHS environment; policy-making
and political engagement; and media communications and content creation.][78]
[Read more][79]
[[Generic and Biosimilar Medications]][80]

### [Our members][81]

[Medicines UK represents 45 pharmaceutical companies that specialise in manufacturing and supplying
the NHS with off-patent generic and biosimilar medicines. These companies provide the vast majority
of treatments patients rely on for their health and well-being. Via competition, they ensure the UK
benefits from the lowest medicine prices in Europe.][82]

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

What does Optimus do?

comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?

regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?

development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia & Brunei, the Philippines, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Orders are delivered
with [NinjaVan][72], [Entrego][73], [CollectCo][74], [Poslaju][75], [TA-Q-BIN][76].

[

### Taobao

][77]

Taobao is the online store focused on the end user. The site operates on the C2C system ("consumer
to consumer") - a form of electronic commerce, which is the sale of goods and services between
consumers. In this case, the site Taobao.com acts as an intermediary between the buyer and seller.
Created by the Alibaba Group to facilitate transactions between individual consumers and a wide
range of sellers, such as retailers and wholesalers, etc. Orders to USA, Canada are delivered by
[UPS][78], [JCEX][79], [China Post EMS][80], to Singapore, Malaysia by [ABX Express][81],
[DEX-I][82], [GDEX][83], [Skynet][84].

[

### Shopee

][85]

Shopee is a mobile marketplace designed for both buyers and sellers to enjoy safe and smooth
transactions – available in Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore. Orders
are delivered with [NinjaVan][86], [ABX Express][87], [Gdex][88], [LBC Express][89], Black Arrow
Express, [Skynet][90], [Poslaju][91].

[

### Gearbest

][92]

Thanks to a rich selection and very low prices, GearBest managed to become one of the most popular
online stores among residents of the United States, Great Britain, Germany, [here you can learn how
to track orders from GearBest][93] using tracking number.

[

### Joom

][94]

Joom Marketplace is a global e-commerce platform founded in 2016 in Riga, Latvia. It helps consumers
to make shopping easy and entertaining and gives access to high quality goods from around the world.
[Track Joom parcels with universal tracker][95].

[

### VOVA.com

][96]

VOVA describes itself as Best Cheap Online Shopping Site - Browse Vova for millions of
cost-efficient products with high quality that make your shopping fun and rewarding. Read more to
find out [how to track VOVA Post][97].

[

### GeekBuying

][98]

GeekBuying is a great online electronics store from China; they focus on home & office electronics,
and consumer electronics; high quality, wholesale price, fast free shipping and good customer
service. Orders are delivered by [China Post][99], [Singapore Post][100], [China Post
EMS/ePacket][101].

[

### Borderfree

][102]

Borderfree lets you shop like a local — delivering the world’s best stores and exclusive savings
directly to you. [Borderfree order tracking][103] accross multiple delivery companies at once.

[

### Wiggle

][104]

British online store of clothing, footwear and accessories for running, swimming, cycling,
triathlon, hiking. Delivery is usually through [P2P TRAKPAK][105] and [MetaPack][106]. [Track Wiggle
orders][107] with our service.

[

### Victoria's Secret

][108]

One of the most famous companies in the world of lingerie. Orders are sent through the aggregator of
the postal services [eShopWorld][109], which forwards packages [Aramex][110], [Asendia][111],
[Chronopost][112]. [Learn more about Victoria's Secret order tracking][113].

[

### TAM Beauty

][114]

TAM Beauty is a popular cosmetics store with adequate prices and fast delivery, orders are most
often sent through [P2P-TrakPak][115], [more about tracking orders from TAM Beauty][116].

[

### DHGate

][117]

DHGate is a marketplace of independent Chinese wholesalers and drop shippers. When you buy through
DHGate, you are buying from one of these sellers, although DHGate handles the transaction. It's a
lot like when you buy something on eBay, but DHGate offers a refund guarantee on all purchases.
Orders are delivered by [China Post][118], [China Post EMS/ePacket][119].

[

### Wayfair

][120]

Wayfair is one of the world's largest online destinations for the home and sells furniture and
home-goods. Their digital platform offers 14 million items from more than 11,000 global suppliers.
Brans include Joss&Main, AllModern, Birch Lane, Perigold. Deliveries are made mainly with
[UPS][121], [FedEx][122], [Canada Post][123], [Royal Mail][124].

[

### Amazon Logistics (AMZL_US)

][125]

Amazon Logistics is a shipping and delivery service meant to complement existing providers like UPS,
US Post and FedEx. It offers 7-day and same-day delivery options, and it utilizes a host of
third-party logistics partners across the country to make it happen – including walkers, bicyclists
and motorcyclists in some areas. Read more to find out [how to track Amazon Logistics][126].

[

### Walmart

][127]

Walmart Inc. is an American multinational retail corporation that operates a chain of hypermarkets,
discount department stores, and grocery stores from the United States. [How to track Walmart
order][128].

[

### Cult Beauty

][129]

THE destination for the very best in beauty, they trawl the globe to create a curated 'Hall of
Fame'. From bestselling skin care to make up must-haves. Orders are delivered with
[P2P-TrakPak][130], read on and find out [more about tracking orders from Cult Beauty][131].

[

### Apple.com

][132]

Track Apple.com orders, shipments, returns and repairs, read on and find out [more about tracking
orders from Apple.com][133].

[

### eGlobal Central

][134]

eGlobal Central offers great discount plus free shipping on latest gadgets: DSLR, lens, mobile,
camera, tablet, audio. Orders are shipped with Central Post courier and delivered by
[wnDirect][135], [DPD][136], [Yodel][137], [DHL Paket][138], read on and find out how to [track
orders from eGlobal Central][139].

[

### Banggood

][140]

Banggood is a relatively young online store, but it is rapidly gaining popularity, orders are sent
mainly through [PostNL][141], [Flyt Express][142], and others. There is a support forum where they
quickly answer questions about package tracking, [more about tracking Banggood orders][143].

[

### Yodel Tracking

][144]

Yodel is a delivery service company in the United Kingdom, and is one of the largest couriers along
with Royal Mail. Read more to find out [how Yodel Tracking works][145].

[

### DPD Tracking

][146]

Dynamic Parcel Distribution or DPD for short is an international express delivery service. DPD has
over 830 terminals in more than 40 countries of the world. Read more to find out [how to track DPD
packages][147]

[

### FedEx SmartPost Tracking

][148]

FedEx SmartPost, which is similar to [UPS SurePost][149], is a hybrid shipping service with which
FedEx will pick up packages from the shipping destination, and then hand the packages off to the
U.S. Postal Service for the final delivery to the end customer. Learn how [FedEx SmartPost
Tracking][150] can help find your package.

[

### Costco

][151]

Costco is a large American warehouse club that sells a wide variety of products in bulk at low
prices, mainly to members who pay an annual fee. It offers groceries, electronics, furniture, and
many other items. For online orders in the U.S., Costco uses various courier services for delivery.

attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.

Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

The **Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors** (VAWD) program was established in 2004 to help
protect the public from the threat of counterfeit drugs. The VAWD program was developed and is
administered by the [National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP)][58]

## Our Products

When it comes to choosing a pharmaceutical company for various brand and generic pharmaceuticals,
it's important to consider factors such as quality, availability, price, and reputation. With
experience since first opening in 2005, at RxOneShop, we have a specialty in [generic][59], [brand
name][60], and [diabetic supplies][61]. Some of our [best-selling pharmaceutical products][62]
include Generic ABILIFY® (aripiprazole), Clobetasol, Omeprazole, generic Synthroid (levothyroxine),
and Lidocaine.

Generic ABILIFY® (aripiprazole) is a medication used to treat various mental or mood disorders,
including schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depression. Clobetasol is a topical steroid used to
treat itching, redness, or specific skin conditions such as eczema and psoriasis. Omeprazole is
commonly used to treat acid reflux and ulcers. Generic Synthroid (levothyroxine) is a medication
used to treat hypothyroidism, and lastly, Lidocaine is a local anesthetic used to numb an area
before a medical procedure.

Let us be your source for diabetic supplies, [short-dated products][63], and [OTC drugs][64]! You
can use our [price check tool][65] to help compare prices with those of your current suppliers. Need
help finding your drugs or supplies? Read here for assistance [finding pharmacy products on our
website][66].

## Welcome to RxOneShop

Our pharmaceutical company works with thousands of pharmacies all across the country. In fact, we
have a partnership selling [pharmaceutical supplies][67] from over 10 suppliers. RxOneShop uses all
the pharmacies buying power to negotiate better prices from our suppliers. This is similar to
joining a buying group except there is no cost to use us and there is no minimum amount of products
that you have to buy.

Over the past 10 years we have grown a lot and the more we continue to grow the more we are able to
push our [wholesale drug suppliers][68] for better prices for each and every pharmacy. Every order
ships for next day delivery free of charge with a $150 minimum order. Our goal is to make sure you
are getting the best possible price every day.

## About RxOneShop

With more than 10 years of industry experience, we are a pharmaceutical manufacturing resource for
thousands of pharmacies across the country for nearly 20 years. We are committed to providing the
best, [lowest prices on pharmaceuticals][69] possible.

Our work is geared towards getting you better prices and making the ordering process as fast and

## How It Works

### Step 1

### Sign Up For Free

Registering is easy and takes less than five minutes. After you have completed the application, we
will review it and contact you within 1 business day with your approval. During the call we will
instruct you on how to complete your first order!

Log into your account using the email you registered with. Once logged in, you can search for the

## Why Choose Our Pharmaceutical Company?

### Free Next Day Shipping

Our expansive inventory with our network of suppliers gives our clients access to immediate order
fulfillment. In order to receive your supplies in a timely fashion, orders will be prepared the same
day if ordered by the cutoff time for free next day shipment on orders meeting a $150 minimum.

[Best Pricing]

### Best Pricing

Our volume based discount pricing model is geared toward finding you the best market rate for
pharmaceuticals. Our software presents specific products in an easy to compare format comparing
different manufacturers and [distributors][57]. We offer 30 day payment terms, and there are no
membership or transaction fees.

[Easy Online Ordering]

### Easy Online Ordering

Browse our online catalog now which offers an extensive listing of thousands of products from
various manufacturers ready for purchase. If the event you need a specific product which may not be
on our list, please contact us and we try to locate it for you at the best possible price.

[VAWD Suppliers]

### VAWD Suppliers

The **Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors** (VAWD) program was established in 2004 to help
protect the public from the threat of counterfeit drugs. The VAWD program was developed and is
administered by the [National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP)][58]

RxOneShop services over pharmacies nationwide

## Our Products

When it comes to choosing a pharmaceutical company for various brand and generic pharmaceuticals,
it's important to consider factors such as quality, availability, price, and reputation. With
experience since first opening in 2005, at RxOneShop, we have a specialty in [generic][59], [brand
name][60], and [diabetic supplies][61]. Some of our [best-selling pharmaceutical products][62]
include Generic ABILIFY® (aripiprazole), Clobetasol, Omeprazole, generic Synthroid (levothyroxine),
and Lidocaine.

Generic ABILIFY® (aripiprazole) is a medication used to treat various mental or mood disorders,
including schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depression. Clobetasol is a topical steroid used to
treat itching, redness, or specific skin conditions such as eczema and psoriasis. Omeprazole is
commonly used to treat acid reflux and ulcers. Generic Synthroid (levothyroxine) is a medication
used to treat hypothyroidism, and lastly, Lidocaine is a local anesthetic used to numb an area
before a medical procedure.

Let us be your source for diabetic supplies, [short-dated products][63], and [OTC drugs][64]! You
can use our [price check tool][65] to help compare prices with those of your current suppliers. Need
help finding your drugs or supplies? Read here for assistance [finding pharmacy products on our
website][66].

Our pharmaceutical company works with thousands of pharmacies all across the country. In fact, we
have a partnership selling [pharmaceutical supplies][67] from over 10 suppliers. RxOneShop uses all
the pharmacies buying power to negotiate better prices from our suppliers. This is similar to
joining a buying group except there is no cost to use us and there is no minimum amount of products
that you have to buy.

Over the past 10 years we have grown a lot and the more we continue to grow the more we are able to
push our [wholesale drug suppliers][68] for better prices for each and every pharmacy. Every order
ships for next day delivery free of charge with a $150 minimum order. Our goal is to make sure you
are getting the best possible price every day.

thousands of pharmacies across the country for nearly 20 years. We are committed to providing the
best, [lowest prices on pharmaceuticals][69] possible.

reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India. 

[Manufacturing and Export Company][Manufacturing and Export Company]

## Worldwide Reach

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

# Health where it matters

[ Know more [arrow] ][67]

## About Us

We are committed to making quality healthcare accessible worldwide. Since 1990, our presence in over
100 countries has been shaped by one purpose to deliver trusted medicines that improve lives and
transform health.

[ Know more [arrow] ][68]

## Global Presence

A worldwide commitment to health, bringing life-saving solutions to every market.

## Product Offerings

From essential generics to speciality formulations, our portfolio is built to meet the diverse and
evolving needs of patients worldwide. We focus on delivering high-quality, differentiated medicines
across a broad range of therapeutic categories, combining scale, innovation, and global reach to
make a meaningful impact in healthcare.

## Research & Development

For us, research & development is a commitment to advancing healthcare through purposeful
innovation. Every formulation we develop and every technology we embrace is guided by a single
vision to deliver high-quality, patient-centric, and accessible medicines to people globally.

[ Know more [arrow] ][69]
[Manufacturing]

## Manufacturing

We are a global healthcare company driven by a strong manufacturing foundation. We have built
advanced manufacturing facilities across continents to deliver high-quality, reliable, and
affordable medicines.

[ Know more [arrow] ][70]
[Quality and global standards]

## Quality and Global Standards

Quality is the foundation of our operations and the benchmark for every decision we make. Through
robust systems, stringent controls, and a culture of accountability, we ensure every product meets
the highest global standards for safety, efficacy, and consistency delivering confidence to
healthcare providers and patients worldwide.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The $4B Patent Cliff: Navigating the Generic Surge as Astellas’ Xtandi Nears Expiration
][13]

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing

levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

### Taj Pharmaceuticals Ltd has it's manufacturing facility for the below mention categories of
### pharmaceutical products.

Tablet 22 lac per shift Capsule 22 lac per shift Injection 2.5 lac per shift Dry Injection 3.5 lac
per shift Small Volume Parenterals 4.5 lac per shift Syrups & Suspensions 1.5 lac per shift
Ointments 2.5 lac per shift Dry Syrups 1.5 lac per shift
Manufacturing (Capacity)

[[flask][flask]][123]State-of-the art Liquid Injections (SVP Line) and General Dry Powder
facilities, which adhere to stringent specifications of GMP and WHO-GMP; We are International
standard contract manufacturing Organization.

[[spinner][spinner]][124]Taj Pharma leverages its India units as cost effective manufacturing
together with its extensive expertise and technology platforms to offer competitive, high quality,
custom manufacturing services to a global clientele. Our facility has been inspected by various
international regulators including the USFDA, GMP, WHO & ISO Certified.

[[clock][clock]][125]Taj Pharma’s manufacturing facilities operate to the highest standards of
quality control. Tests produced at all four of our sites are manufactured to stringent levels of
reliability, reproducibility and stability.

> Once again, welcome to [Taj Pharmaceuticals][126], a great company that is translating a great
> vision of generics into reality – We Innovate Generics Healthcare.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing

Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications

## Pharmaceutical Distribution

At VR Healthcare, we bridge the gap between India's leading pharmaceutical manufacturers and the
healthcare providers who need them. With a focus on Quality, Availability, and Affordability, we
ensure your shelves are never empty.

* ### Our Vision
* ### Our History

To empower healthcare providers by ensuring seamless access to high-quality, branded generic
medicines through a robust and transparent wholesale distribution network. We are committed to
bridging the gap between global pharmaceutical leaders and local care providers with integrity and
operational excellence.

* Authentic Sourcing

for our diverse product portfolio, ethical business practices, and unwavering commitment to

therapy segments.

# At Zentiva, we provide health and wellbeing for all generations

We develop, produce, and deliver high-quality, affordable medicines to more than 100 million people
in over 40 countries across Europe. Our four manufacturing sites and a broad network of external
manufacturing partners help to ensure supply security. Zentiva employs more than 5,400 dedicated
professionals in over 30 countries, bonded together by a commitment to the people who depend on our
products every day.

**Zentiva UK** is proud to support the NHS by delivering high-quality, affordable medicines that

We develop, produce, and deliver high-quality, affordable medicines to more than 100 million people
in over 40 countries across Europe. Our four manufacturing sites and a broad network of external
manufacturing partners help to ensure supply security. Zentiva employs more than 5,400 dedicated
professionals in over 30 countries, bonded together by a commitment to the people who depend on our
products every day.

**Zentiva UK** is proud to support the NHS by delivering high-quality, affordable medicines that
meet the evolving needs of patients and healthcare providers. Our portfolio spans retail and
hospital generics, branded generics, value-added medicines, and biosimilars—each designed to enhance
access, improve outcomes, and reduce prescribing costs across the UK. With a strong commitment to
sustainability, innovation, and reliable supply, Zentiva UK works hand-in-hand with NHS stakeholders
to ensure continuity of care and long-term value for the health system.

**Zentiva UK** is proud to support the NHS by delivering high-quality, affordable medicines that
meet the evolving needs of patients and healthcare providers. Our portfolio spans retail and
hospital generics, branded generics, value-added medicines, and biosimilars—each designed to enhance
access, improve outcomes, and reduce prescribing costs across the UK. With a strong commitment to
sustainability, innovation, and reliable supply, Zentiva UK works hand-in-hand with NHS stakeholders
to ensure continuity of care and long-term value for the health system.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
